newCharacters.name: Pepper
newCharacters.description: Young witch with a huge floppy witch hat with cat-ear tips, red vest, plaid cuffs and a ponytail. Hair looks brown, purple or green depending on the panel's coloured lighting; always the same girl who rides with Carrot.

newCharacters.name: Carrot
newCharacters.description: Small orange tabby cat with big eyes who rides on Pepper's shoulder or her broom.

newCharacters.name: Cayenne
newCharacters.description: Pepper's stern duel opponent: sharp scowling face, dark pointed hat with a belt buckle, dark coat; looks green in the green-lit panels. Pepper calls them 'master Cayenne'.

newCharacters.name: Elder Witch
newCharacters.description: Old witch with a big white afro of hair and a big nose, who stops the duel and calls everyone over.
